description_preview:
Overview
Meds.com is a rapidly growing consumer technology firm operating a suite of healthcare businesses, including our flagship brand BlueChew. Our mission is to better patients' lives through innovative healthcare solutions. With a team of 350 professionals across various specialties, we've built scalable pharmacy, telemedicine, and e-commerce platforms using cutting-edge technology. As we continue our accelerated growth trajectory, we're launching new products to expand our patient base and accelerate growth. Join us in tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
At BlueChew, "Fullstack" means more than just connecting a database to a UI. You will be building the digital bridge between a patient's medical consultation and the physical delivery of their prescription. This role is for an engineer who thrives on the "hard problems" of healthcare - maintaining strict HIPAA - compliant security and high-availability systems while delivering the sleek, intuitive user experience of a modern D2C brand.
Join our team in Austin, TX or Chicago, IL - we are looking for someone who truly values and enjoys working in the office, not just tolerates it.
Responsibilities
Architect and build key features for major business areas such as pharmacy operations, ecommerce, and telemedicine.
Produce high quality code for peer review
Provide technical guidance for junior engineers
Code review for peers
Technology Utilization
Main programming languages: TypeScript, Python, Ruby
Databases: SQL and no-SQL, BigQuery, MongoDB
Frameworks, key libraries, and runtime: Angular, Node JS, AWS Chime, FreeSwitch
Infrastructure: Google Cloud, AWS, GitHub, and on-premise servers
Project management: Azure DevOps
Notable Projects & Accomplishments
Telemedicine Platform: Proprietary system with EHR (electronic health records) integration, web-based video calls, and SIP-to-web voice conversion
Pharmacy Software: Scalable system handling high-volume prescription fulfillment
E-commerce Engine: Includes integrated shipping, payments, email, and more
Qualifications
Education & Experience
BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Math, Science, Engineering, Economics, or other highly quantitative disciplines, or equivalent experience.
Solid grasp of computer science foundations, mainly algorithms and data structures
Expertise in one or more modern programming languages. Examples are TypeScript, Javascript, Python, Go, C++, Java, etc
Ideal Profile
Has written lots of non-trivial code
Has had to design creative engineering solutions frequently
A problem solver with a sound computer science background.
Enjoys coming up with a new code architecture, studying a new open-source library, building a new internal library, and designing the detailed steps to implement a big feature
Ability to learn quickly how a standard computer science algorithm works, such as graph algorithms, sorting algorithms, etc.
Should possess real expertise in at least one programming language.
BS, MS, PhD in Computer Science, Math, Science, Engineering, Economics, or other highly quantitative disciplines, or equivalent experience
Strong understanding of core computer science principles, including algorithms and data structures
Proficiency in at least one or more modern programming language such as TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, C++, or Java
Highlights
Competitive Pay
Work on the ground floor launching new DTC medications
Be on the cutting edge of both telemedicine and software engineering
Contribute as a core team member of the SWE team
Interview Process
15 minute HR Screening
1 hour take home test with a sequence of algorithm challenges screen recorded, first 30 min without AI help, and 30 min with optional AI help
1 hour live technical interview with a team member focused on algorithms
Additional technical interview with a team member focused on algorithms (1 hour)
Final round: on-site visit to our Austin office or video interview with CEO, CTO, and other senior members of the team
Perks
100% company-paid Medical, Dental, Vision premium coverage,plus Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance.
401K with company match.
Paid time off and company-paid holidays
Enjoy free daily lunch
We are looking for top-talent that wants to make a measurable impact in an exciting, fast-paced environment. This role is full-time in Elmhurst, IL.

About Us
Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.
We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.
Job:
We’re hiring a design engineer to help shape and build interactive experiences across Parallel’s website, product, and special projects. The work ranges from refining everyday interactions and motion to creating visual essays, data visualizations, launch pages, and minisites.
You’ll work alongside designers, marketers, and engineers from the first rough idea through to production. That means prototyping possible directions, contributing to our core website, and getting the details right in the browser. You’ll also build reusable components and patterns that help us ship the next project faster.
You:
You’re a design engineer or a frontend engineer with strong design instincts. Your work shows care for typography, layout, and the timing and feel of an interaction. You’ve shipped working websites and can point to the decisions you made along the way. You’re comfortable with modern frontend and animation libraries, and know when to build something custom. You move quickly in prototypes and carry that work through to a responsive, accessible, performant site.
About Parallel Design:
We design for a web used by both people and agents, grounding our work in real code, data, and evidence. We draw from the history of the web, computing, and publishing to help explain what comes next, while leaving room for experiments, tangents, and things made simply because they’re good.
Life at Parallel
Our team works
fully in-person

Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

Role Overview
We are looking for a mid-level DevOps Engineer to build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, reusable workflows, Docker, Artifactory, and SonarQube. This role will work closely with development, QA, and security teams to improve build reliability, automate deployments, and standardize engineering workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub Enterprise Server.
Create reusable workflows, workflow templates, and composite actions that development teams can adopt across repositories.
Manage self-hosted runners, repository settings, permissions, secrets, and branch protection rules.
Build and maintain Docker images and support container-based build and deployment processes.
Integrate Artifactory for package and container image management and SonarQube for code quality checks.
Automate build, test, security scan, and deployment steps across development and production environments.
Work with developers to resolve pipeline failures, improve build times, and document standard practices.
Support infrastructure and deployment automation using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools.
Required Qualifications
5–6 years of experience in DevOps, build engineering, platform engineering, or a related role.
Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, including YAML workflows, reusable workflows, templates, and self-hosted runners.
Strong experience administering or supporting GitHub Enterprise Server.
Hand-on experience with Docker, Artifactory, and SonarQube.
Proficiency in Bash, Python, or a similar scripting language.
Hand-on knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and release management.
Experience troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and collaborating with software development teams.
Familiarity with Linux systems, access controls, and secure management of pipeline credentials.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Kubernetes and deployment tools such as Helm or Argo CD.
Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience integrating automated tests, dependency scans, and container scans into CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.

Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem.
Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership.
Our People create value and are our Most Valuable asset. We take our values of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork and Taking Ownership seriously and ask candidates to think about how they can help us further enhance our culture with their specific skillsets, capabilities and experiences.
Benefits
We provide our team the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and continue in their career growth. We are committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits that include 100% employer paid premium healthcare, paid parental leave and more.
About The Role
Designed for an electrical engineering student approaching graduation, the Substation Engineer role offers the opportunity to develop specialized expertise in high-voltage substation engineering. The engineer will support the development, design, construction, and operation of new and existing substations.
Responsibilities
What You Will Do
Support competitive proposals and project development activities involving substation engineering, procurement, and construction.
Support the preparation and review of substation design packages, including physical layouts, material specifications, and construction specifications.
Review protection and control designs and related electrical studies and reports.
Develop and review project cost and schedule estimates.
Evaluate engineering, procurement, and construction alternatives to identify solutions that balance cost, safety, reliability, constructability, schedule, and other project requirements.
Provide technical support for new and existing substation assets during development, construction, and operations.
Support the management of engineering, procurement, and construction contracts and coordinate with consultants and contractors.
Qualifications
We Want You On Our Team Because You
Have a Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from an accredited college or university, with an expected graduation date of December 2026 or May 2027.
Have an understanding of electric-power systems developed through coursework, research, internships, or academic projects.
Have an interest in high-voltage substation engineering, procurement, and construction.
Can perform technical analyses, interpret results, and clearly explain and support conclusions.
Have strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
Can manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
Work effectively with others.
Take initiative to learn unfamiliar technical subjects and address new challenges.
Ideally, You Also Have...
Internship, co-op, research, or academic project experience involving electric-power systems or high-voltage substations.

description_preview:
About Dexmate
Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.
If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.
The Role
We are looking for an Electrical & Firmware Test Engineer to make sure the electrical systems and embedded software in Dexmate robots work reliably in the real world. You will own validation of power systems, batteries, boards, harnesses, and motor controllers, and build the hardware-in-the-loop infrastructure that tests our firmware before it reaches a robot. You will find problems before customers do — and help fix them.
This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time at the bench and in the lab — probing boards, building rigs, running tests, and debugging failures yourself. We care most about what you have actually built, tested, and debugged.
Responsibilities
Define and execute electrical validation plans for power distribution, battery packs and BMS, custom boards, motor drives, sensors, harnesses, and connectors
Define reliability test flows for PCBAs, harnesses, and connectors, and run them: power cycling, brown-out and fault conditions, high temperature/high humidity, thermal cycling and shock, connector and harness flex/wear, and long-duration burn-in
Run ESD and EMC pre-compliance testing; support FCC, CE, and UL certification with external labs
Validate battery safety and performance, and support battery certification (IEC 62133, UN38.3)
Build and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test rigs for motor controllers, joint modules, and main compute boards
Develop automated firmware regression tests covering communications (CAN, EtherCAT, Ethernet), control loops, safety behaviors, and OTA updates
Perform fault-injection testing to verify error handling and safe-state behavior
Lead electrical failure analysis at board and system level, working with electrical and firmware engineers to drive fixes
Write test procedures and maintain test data and reports
Minimum Qualifications
BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience — proven test and debug work matters more to us than the degree
4+ years of hands-on experience in electrical validation, hardware test, or embedded test for robotics, automotive, industrial, or consumer electronics
Strong bench skills: oscilloscopes, current probes, power analyzers, electronic loads, thermal cameras
Ability to read schematics and debug at board level
Experience testing power electronics, battery systems, or motor drives
Proficiency in Python for test automation and comfort working in Linux
Familiarity with embedded systems and communication buses (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building HIL test systems and firmware CI pipelines
Experience with EtherCAT or real-time motor control systems
Hands-on EMC/ESD pre-compliance testing and certification experience (FCC, CE, UL)
Knowledge of battery safety standards (IEC 62133, UN38.3, UL 2271)
Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 61508)
Ability to read and write embedded C/C++

reject_reason: Title disqualified: Senior Software Engineer - Machine Learning and AI
description_preview:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Machine Learning and AI based in United States.
As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in Machine Learning and AI, you’ll build and deploy intelligent systems that power real-time decisions across a large-scale digital giving platform.
You’ll work on personalization, recommendations, fraud detection, risk scoring, and other high-impact applications of machine learning and AI.
The role combines deep technical problem-solving with end-to-end ownership, from mathematical formulation and experimentation through production deployment.
You’ll work with large-scale donor and transaction datasets while building reliable, low-latency services that operate at significant scale.
Your models will directly influence how people discover meaningful causes, develop consistent giving habits, and experience safe and trusted transactions.
As part of a research-focused engineering team, you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and scientists while contributing to a purpose-driven, human-centered environment.
The role also offers opportunities to mentor others, strengthen engineering and scientific standards, and solve complex problems where machine learning can create meaningful impact.
Accountabilities
Research, prototype, and evaluate computational, statistical, machine learning, and AI models using real-world donor and transaction datasets.
Translate ambiguous product challenges into well-defined ML problems, including ranking, classification, anomaly detection, and recommendation use cases, with clear success metrics and evaluation methodologies.
Design and productize machine learning systems that deliver personalized recommendations and help users connect with the organizations and causes most relevant to them.
Build AI systems capable of processing large volumes of real-time data across applications such as fraud prevention, risk scoring, engineering reliability, and other business and product challenges.
Develop and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines covering feature engineering, large-scale data processing, model training, evaluation, experimentation, A/B testing, and deployment.
Build and operate real-time inference services in partnership with Platform and DevOps teams, ensuring scalability, low latency, reliability, and effective monitoring.
Own the production quality and reliability of models, continuously balancing product objectives with false positives and negative user experiences.
Ensure model behavior aligns with responsible product principles and supports positive, trustworthy experiences.
Mentor engineers on machine learning best practices while raising standards for scientific rigor, reproducibility, and code quality.
Requirements
Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, another STEM discipline, or equivalent research experience.
2+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production, ideally including systems serving hundreds of thousands to millions of users.
Strong mathematical foundation in probability and statistics, linear algebra, and optimization, with an ability to understand the underlying principles behind model behavior.
Hands-on experience with both classical machine learning and deep learning approaches, such as gradient-boosted trees, embedding models, and transformers, with sound judgment about when to apply each technique.
Experience with large-scale data processing, distributed training, feature stores, and modern ML tooling such as Spark, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and MLflow or similar platforms.
Demonstrated experience in one or more relevant areas, such as recommender systems, fraud or risk modeling, search ranking, or real-time classification.
Research experience through publications, thesis work, or applied research, with the ability to translate novel methods into production solutions, is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex challenges creatively using data, sound judgment, and collaboration.
Scientific rigor, including a commitment to strong baselines, honest evaluation, reproducibility, and measurable outcomes.
Strong ownership mindset and accountability for taking ML systems from experimentation and design through production and ongoing performance.
Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and product teams.
A customer-focused and human-centered approach to building solutions that anticipate user needs and promote positive experiences.
High integrity and sound judgment, with a commitment to acting responsibly and making principled decisions.
Benefits
Competitive compensation.
Comprehensive benefits designed to support employees’ health and long-term well-being.
Flexible paid time off.
Additional employee perks and support programs.
Fully virtual work environment with opportunities to collaborate with high-performing professionals.
Meaningful work at the intersection of machine learning, AI, personalization, fraud prevention, and real-time decision-making.
Opportunity to contribute to products designed around human needs and positive social impact.
Collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity, integrity, innovation, and purpose.
Opportunities for professional growth, mentorship, and continuous learning.

# Senior AI/ML Engineer
## About the Role
UnitedHealth Group is seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and scale artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that improve healthcare experiences. The role involves developing production-ready AI/ML solutions and working with cross-functional teams to bring machine learning models into operational environments.
You will contribute to model deployment using robust MLOps practices and governance, with opportunities to work across software, data, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. The position is available remotely nationwide or in office-based locations in Minnesota or Washington, DC.

* Design, build, and scale AI/ML solutions.
* Develop machine learning solutions that improve healthcare experiences.
* Deploy machine learning models into production environments.
* Apply MLOps practices to support reliable model deployment and operations.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout AI/ML development and deployment.
* Work with cloud technologies to develop and scale AI/ML solutions.
## Required Qualifications
* 5+ years of experience in software, data, AI, or related fields.
* 3+ years of experience deploying machine learning models.
* Strong Python expertise.
